purpose: Directed assertion simulation for the approved signed-33 cross-beat accumulator change in road_mac_probe.

arithmetic_contract.overflow: INT32 range checked only for an accepted last group
arithmetic_contract.fault_payload: all three external INT32 lanes are zero when any final lane overflows

directed_coverage: positive temporary INT32 excursion followed by legal recovery
negative temporary INT32 excursion followed by legal recovery
positive and negative final overflow independently in alpha, beta, and gamma
24-beat 192-term legal result with INT32_MIN and INT32_MAX biases
INT32_MAX + 192*16384 exact positive proof endpoint and atomic fault
INT32_MIN + 192*(-16256) exact negative proof endpoint and atomic fault
tail mask with nonzero extreme values in disabled lanes
bias used once even when later beats present different extreme bias ports
input valid and payload held while busy
asynchronous reset cancellation at product, pair, quad, dot, candidate, hold, final, decision, writeback, and output-hold stages
result-ready asserted before the recovered result-valid, followed by a sampled handshake, one-cycle terminal, normal release, and no repeated or ghost terminal

white_box_checks.accept_plus_4: all 3 dot registers, full reg_base_dot[98:0], and flag_stage_valid[2]
white_box_checks.accept_plus_9: full reg_accumulator[98:0] writeback and optional external terminal

modes.candidate: Runs all 84 deterministic beats, ten reset cancellation probes, and one pre-ready terminal regression.
modes.legacy_negative: With +LEGACY_NEGATIVE, frozen 96-bit core must reject the first non-last beat of each recovery sequence with a fault and all-zero payload.

strict_note: This harness is directed assertion simulation, not a formal proof or release gate by itself.
